hero.name: Sharif
hero.role: I build realtime systems, developer tools, and the software that ships them.
hero.intro: From a WebRTC video platform to a C/C++ toolchain that packages Python, PHP and Node apps into a single binary. Self-taught since 2018, shipping since day one.

about.heading: From Wapka to RealBrain.
about.lede: A self-taught path that started on a mobile site builder and led to C/C++ toolchains, WebRTC signaling and production systems.
story: I first discovered the magic of building for the web through Wapka. Inspired, I created FriendsClub, a small social platform where people could post, chat, and connect.

When Wapka shut down, I doubled down on learning to build it all myself. PHP was my starting point, then JavaScript to rebuild FriendsClub from scratch. That rebuild became the pattern for everything since: find the missing tool, then build it.

highlights.text: Explored Python & C for competitive programming and problem solving
Built an Android WebView app for FriendsClub
Learned full-stack: Core PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Express, Python (FastAPI, Django), and Java
Adopted Linux & Bash for server management and automation
